rubric_items.reason: All 16 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-16) are traced by at least one story; no assumed or unknown REQs exist in the intent.
Most stories carry one outcome; S-5 bundles list label, detail-page label, status filter and dashboard tiles in one story.
ACs are Given/When/Then and bracket the 24h boundary at 09:59/10:01, catching end-time or next-local-day variants; times carry no time zone although the app renders in a configured zone.
The only rule value is 24h from REQ-2; dates and clock times are example instants with the 24h offset derived inline.
Clear, consistent use of Scheduled, Stale, Completed, No-show, Cancelled matching the glossary and intent.

findings.text: S-1, S-2 and S-4 ACs give clock times (10:00 on 3 December, 10:01 on 4 December) without saying they are hospital local time, while the app stores instants and renders them in a configured time zone; a local-vs-UTC mix-up could pass or fail depending on how a tester reads them.

cites.quote: Given a Scheduled appointment that starts at 10:00 on 3 December and is not marked Completed or rescheduled

findings.suggested_fix: State once that all AC times are hospital local time (and that the 24h is elapsed time from the stored start instant).

findings.text: S-5 bundles four outcomes (list label, appointment-page label, status filter, dashboard tiles) across REQ-12, REQ-13, REQ-14; the filter and dashboard checks could stand as separate small stories.

cites.quote: when staff filter the appointment list by status Stale, then only the Stale appointment is listed

findings.suggested_fix: Split S-5 into label display (REQ-12), status filter (REQ-13) and dashboard unchanged (REQ-14).

cites.quote: A Scheduled appointment that has not been marked Completed or `rescheduled` by 24h after its start time is marked Stale.
